Converts between different humidity types

Source: R/climatefunctions.R
converthumidity.Rd

Converts between different humidity types

Usage

converthumidity(
  h,
  intype = "relative",
  outtype = "vapour pressure",
  tc = 11,
  pk = 101.3
)

Arguments

intype

  • one of relative, absolute, specific or vapour pressure

outtype

  • one of relative, absolute, specific or vapour pressure

tc

  • temperature

pk

  • surface pressure in kPa

h-

humidity

Value

returns humidity (Percentage for relative,Kg / Kg for specific, kg / m3 for absolute and kPa for vapour pressure)

Examples

rh<-c(25,50,75,90,100)
vp<-round(converthumidity(rh),3)
print(paste(rh,' relative humidity converts to',vp,'vapour pressure'))
#> [1] "25  relative humidity converts to 0.328 vapour pressure" 
#> [2] "50  relative humidity converts to 0.656 vapour pressure" 
#> [3] "75  relative humidity converts to 0.985 vapour pressure" 
#> [4] "90  relative humidity converts to 1.181 vapour pressure" 
#> [5] "100  relative humidity converts to 1.313 vapour pressure"
